messages.content:
You are the Functional Analyst of a legacy modernization platform. You receive the business rules extracted from a
legacy program and group them into user stories that a product owner will review before the migration starts.

How to group:
- One story per feature or capability the business recognises (for example "Pay an order from a company account"),
  not one story per rule. A story usually links two to six rules.
- Every rule must be linked to at least one story. Do not invent behaviour that is not in the rules.

Each story has:
- `feature`: the capability it belongs to.
- `title`: short, in business language.
- `narrative`: "As a <role>, I want <goal>, so that <benefit>."
- `criteria`: acceptance criteria, each one Gherkin scenario with concrete values taken from the rules. Every
  scenario starts with `Scenario:` and a name, has at least one Given, one When and one Then, in that order, one
  behaviour per scenario, and scenario names are unique within the story. A `Scenario Outline:` needs an
  `Examples:` table whose columns are exactly its `<placeholders>`.
- `links`: the ids of the rules it covers (RULE-001...).
- `priority`: P0 if any linked rule is P0, otherwise the highest priority of its rules.
- `estimate`: relative size from 1 to 13.

Answer with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"stories": [{"feature": "...", "title": "...", "narrative": "As a ..., I want ..., so that ...",
  "criteria": ["Scenario: ...\n  Given ...\n  When ...\n  Then ..."], "links": ["RULE-001"], "priority": "P0",
  "estimate": 3}]}

Business rules:
[
 {
  "id": "RULE-001",
  "name": "Base commission: flat fee up to 1000, otherwise 0.1% of amount",
  "category": "calculation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "If the transaction amount is 1000.00 or less, the commission is a flat 0.50. Above 1000.00, the commission is 0.1% of the amount, rounded to 2 decimals with midpoints rounded away from zero.",
  "condition": "monto <= 1000 -> flat fee; monto > 1000 -> percentage fee",
  "action": "comision = 0.50 when monto <= 1000.00; otherwise comision = Round(monto * 0.001, 2, AwayFromZero)",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Amount at the flat-fee limit\n Given monto is 1000.00\n When the commission is calculated\n Then the base commission is 0.50",
   "Scenario: Amount above the limit\n Given monto is 3000.00\n When the commission is calculated\n Then the base commission is 3.00",
   "Scenario: Midpoint rounding\n Given monto is 3500.50\n When the commission is calculated\n Then the base commission is 3.50 (3.5005 rounded to 2 decimals)",
   "Scenario: Just above the limit\n Given monto is 1000.01\n When the commission is calculated\n Then the base commission is 1.00"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-002",
  "name": "Commission cap of 5.00 before surcharge",
  "category": "policy",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The base commission is never more than 5.00. Any base commission above 5.00 is reduced to 5.00.",
  "condition": "comision > 5.00",
  "action": "comision = 5.00",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Commission above the cap\n Given monto is 10000.00, so the base commission is 10.00\n When the cap is applied\n Then the commission is 5.00",
   "Scenario: Commission below the cap\n Given monto is 3000.00, so the base commission is 3.00\n When the cap is applied\n Then the commission stays 3.00"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-003",
  "name": "Surcharge of 1.00 for type INM, applied after the cap",
  "category": "calculation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "When the operation type is \"INM\", a fixed 1.00 is added to the commission. The surcharge is added after the 5.00 cap, so an INM commission can reach 6.00.",
  "condition": "tipo == \"INM\" (case-sensitive comparison)",
  "action": "comision = comision + 1.00, after the cap has been applied",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: INM with a small amount\n Given tipo is \"INM\" and monto is 500.00\n When the commission is calculated\n Then the commission is 1.50",
   "Scenario: INM with a capped commission\n Given tipo is \"INM\" and monto is 10000.00\n When the commission is calculated\n Then the commission is 6.00",
   "Scenario: Other type\n Given tipo is \"XYZ\" and monto is 10000.00\n When the commission is calculated\n Then the commission is 5.00"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-004",
  "name": "Transfer receipt shows the stored amount with two decimals, blank if the transfer does not exist",
  "category": "policy",
  "priority": "P2",
  "statement": "The transfer receipt displays the requested transfer number and the amount recorded for that transfer in TRANSFERENCIAS, formatted with two decimals (\"0.00\"). If no transfer exists with that number, the amount is shown blank and no error is raised.",
  "condition": "Look up TRF_MONTO in TRANSFERENCIAS where TRF_NUMERO equals the requested number. If a row is found, the amount is available. Otherwise it is not.",
  "action": "Show the transfer number as text. If an amount was found, show it formatted as \"0.00\". If not, show an empty string.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Existing transfer\n Given transfer 1001 exists in TRANSFERENCIAS with TRF_MONTO 2500.5\n When the receipt page is opened with numero=1001\n Then the number is shown as \"1001\" and the amount as \"2500.50\"",
   "Scenario: Unknown transfer\n Given no transfer 9999 exists in TRANSFERENCIAS\n When the receipt page is opened with numero=9999\n Then the number is shown as \"9999\" and the amount is shown as an empty string"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-005",
  "name": "Source and destination accounts must differ",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "A transfer cannot be made to the same account it is debited from. If the origin and destination account values are equal (`origen == destino`), the handler sets lblMensaje.Text to 'LA CUENTA DESTINO ES LA MISMA' and returns immediately, skipping the rest of the method.",
  "condition": "trimmed origen == trimmed destino",
  "action": "Show 'LA CUENTA DESTINO ES LA MISMA' and stop; no database access occurs.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Same account\n Given origin account '1001' and destination account '1001'\n When the user submits the transfer\n Then the message 'LA CUENTA DESTINO ES LA MISMA' is shown\n And no transfer is made"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-006",
  "name": "Origin account must exist and be active",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The origin account must exist in CUENTAS and have status 'A' (active). Otherwise the transfer is rejected and the transaction is rolled back ('CUENTA ORIGEN NO EXISTE' or 'CUENTA ORIGEN INACTIVA').",
  "condition": "no CUENTAS row for origen, or CTA_ESTADO != 'A'",
  "action": "Roll back, show the matching message and stop.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Origin account does not exist\n Given no account '9999' in CUENTAS\n When a transfer is requested from '9999'\n Then 'CUENTA ORIGEN NO EXISTE' is shown and the transaction is rolled back",
   "Scenario: Origin account inactive\n Given account '1001' has status 'I'\n When a transfer is requested from '1001'\n Then 'CUENTA ORIGEN INACTIVA' is shown and the transaction is rolled back"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-007",
  "name": "Destination account must exist and be active",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The destination account must exist in CUENTAS with status 'A'. If not, the transfer is rejected with 'CUENTA DESTINO NO EXISTE'. A non-active destination gives the same message as a missing one.",
  "condition": "COUNT(CUENTAS where CTA_NUMERO = destino and CTA_ESTADO = 'A') == 0",
  "action": "Roll back, show 'CUENTA DESTINO NO EXISTE' and stop.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Destination inactive or missing\n Given destination account '2002' is not active or does not exist\n When the transfer is requested\n Then 'CUENTA DESTINO NO EXISTE' is shown and the transaction is rolled back"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-008",
  "name": "Sufficient balance covering amount plus commission",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The origin account balance must cover the transfer amount plus the commission calculated for the amount and transfer type. Otherwise the transfer is rejected with 'SALDO INSUFICIENTE'.",
  "condition": "saldo < monto + ComisionService.Calcular(monto, tipo)",
  "action": "Roll back, show 'SALDO INSUFICIENTE' and stop.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Insufficient balance\n Given the origin balance is 100.00, the amount is 100.00 and the commission is 2.00\n When the transfer is requested\n Then 'SALDO INSUFICIENTE' is shown and nothing is debited",
   "Scenario: Exact balance\n Given balance 102.00, amount 100.00, commission 2.00\n When the transfer is requested\n Then the balance check passes"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-009",
  "name": "Transfer posting: debit amount plus commission, credit amount, record transfer",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "A valid transfer debits the origin account by amount plus commission and credits the destination with the amount only (the commission is retained by the bank). It records a TRANSFERENCIAS row with the next sequential number (MAX+1, or 1 if empty), and commits all changes in one transaction.",
  "condition": "All validations pass",
  "action": "Origin balance -= monto + comision; destination balance += monto; number = ISNULL(MAX(TRF_NUMERO),0)+1; insert TRANSFERENCIAS (number, origin, destination, amount, commission, type); commit; show commission and 'TRANSFERENCIA REALIZADA'; redirect to Comprobante.aspx?numero=<number>.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Successful transfer\n Given origin 1001 with balance 500.00, active destination 2002, amount 100.00, commission 2.00, and the last transfer number is 41\n When the transfer is requested\n Then origin balance becomes 398.00\n And destination balance increases by 100.00\n And transfer 42 is recorded with commission 2.00\n And 'TRANSFERENCIA REALIZADA' is shown"
  ]
 }
]

],
"links": ["RULE-001", "RULE-002", "RULE-003"],

{

"feature": "Account transfer",

"criteria": [

  When the transfer is requested

  And nothing is debited",

"Scenario: First transfer ever recorded

  When the transfer is requested

],
"links": ["RULE-008", "RULE-009"],
"priority": "P0",
"estimate": 5
},
{
"feature": "Transfer receipt",
"title": "View the receipt of a transfer",
"narrative": "As a bank customer, I want to open the receipt of a transfer by its number, so that I can see the amount that was recorded for it.",
"criteria": [
"Scenario: Receipt of an existing transfer
  Given transfer 1001 exists in TRANSFERENCIAS with TRF_MONTO 2500.5
  When the receipt page is opened with numero=1001
  Then the number is shown as "1001"
  And the amount is shown as "2500.50"",
"Scenario: Receipt of an unknown transfer
  Given no transfer 9999 exists in TRANSFERENCIAS

  And no error is raised"
],
"links": ["RULE-004"],
